messages.text: Hi, I want to refund the porcelain gravy boat from my order delivered 34 days ago—my first proposal for it was made on time 12 days ago before it stopped being valid due to an order update. Could you also give me the receipt number for the ceramic soup tureen that was already refunded?

messages.text:
A staff member will take over your gravy boat refund: your earlier proposal was made on time and later became invalid, so the passed deadline requires staff review rather than a late-request refusal (refund-policy/v2/window).

Your ceramic soup tureen was already refunded **BRL 46.33** to the order’s original payment. Its receipt number is **R-H461-0001**; that unit cannot be refunded again (refund-policy/v2/remaining).
